hero.title: About GeoAnalyzer
hero.subtitle: Intelligent platform for finding the perfect neighborhood to live in

mission.text_1: GeoAnalyzer is a modern tool for urban environment analysis. We believe that choosing a place to live should be based on verified facts, not guesswork.
mission.text_2: Our goal is to provide users with simple and convenient access to comprehensive district analytics, helping to find the perfect balance between comfort, safety, and cost of living.

features.title: Detailed Analytics
features.text: District evaluation by 6 key indicators: education, transport, safety, ecology, medicine, and commerce.

features.title: Up-to-date Data
features.text: We aggregate information from open sources and structure it for easy understanding.

features.title: Favorites
features.text: Save interesting districts in your personal account for quick access and comparison.

features.title: Safe Choice
features.text: Make moving decisions based on objective figures, not just emotions.

features.title: Convenience
features.text: Adaptive interface allows exploring cities from both computer and smartphone.

features.title: Scaling
features.text: We constantly add new cities and expand the district database.

process.title: Choose Location
process.text: Select the country and city you are interested in using convenient filters.

process.title: Analyze Indicators
process.text: View district ratings by criteria important to you (schools, transport, parks).

process.title: Add to Favorites
process.text: Create your own shortlist of the best places to live.

process.title: Make Decisions
process.text: Use comprehensive data to choose the perfect place for your home.

data_sources.title: Infrastructure Data:
items: Location of educational institutions and hospitals

audience.title: For Families
audience.text: Find districts with the best schools, kindergartens, and safe courtyards.

audience.title: For Tenants
audience.text: Evaluate location convenience before signing a lease agreement.

audience.title: For Investors
audience.text: Analyze district attractiveness for purchasing real estate.

audience.title: For New Residents
audience.text: Quickly orient yourself in a new city and find a comfortable environment.
